title: Future Juice Mango Passionfruit 10ml E-Liquid
description: Mango Passionfruit by Future Juice blends two bold tropical flavours into a punchy, sunshine-soaked vape. Sweet, juicy Mango sets the tone with its unmistakable softness and depth, while the sharp tang of Passionfruit cuts through with a bright, super-sweet edge. The contrast between the rich fruitiness and tropical pop makes this an especially vibrant option for tropical fruit fans looking for a little extra character in their vape. This e-liquid uses nicotine salts to deliver a silky-smooth, yet tactile throat hit and fast-acting nicotine satisfaction. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it's ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it offers the flexibility to suit a wide range of preferences. Future Juice’s Nic Salt collection is crafted in the UK by a team of flavour experts focused on creating bold, reliable e-liquids that perform brilliantly in modern low-powered vape kits.
